description: We are studying engineering in data science we are prepared for any challenge that we are going to face
summary: We developed a Website called OrbirtalFarm, this website helps the farmers with predicctions, soil and weather analysis based on NASA DATA, Mexican Secretary of Agriculture and INEGI (National Institute of Statistics and Geography)  with recomendations of crop rotation and also historical weather of the region , prediction of total harvest of the crop, we suggest best type of crop on the region selected, region that the user selects on a GPS map in the website,the user also selects the size of his farm(ha) for the predictions of the harvest, it is helpfull and even necessary to make the desicion of the farmers easier.
details:
OrbitalFarm

The Website predicts, recomends and analyze the crop of the user/farmer that uses our website, based on NASA and mexican Institutions weather and geographics DATA, it have an location system with interactive an map, its open to diferent types of irrigation, diferent types of crops, it recomend the most popular and favorable crop based on the region, it is also open to any type of crop, with an interactive system for measuring land in hectares, provides an analysis based on data collected by the program also a bilingual interface, we have the purpose to help the farmers to cope with sudden climate changes, and have more information and guidance for making decisions regarding planting and crop rotation, we used Antigravity IDE ,Gemini AI,Claude Code, for code we used JavaScript,HTML,Python and CSS for coding language , our proyect its creative because we think that the agricultural sector is a neglected and underserved sector, this website helps the farmers with an interactive and easy interface, with no technical terms and easy to understand the reasons why, our team considered several factors, for the interface we considered the knowledge, time, financial resources, and accessibility to basic information among the average farming public and for the operation of our program we used variables that the NASA resources and Mexican Institution Stablished for agriculture profileration.
